_about: Dispatcher settings. Edit on GitHub; the next run (every 15 min) picks them up. Each agent is one routine on one Claude account. pool 'admin' = planning and triage only (no code); 'home' agents only serve repos that carry the label home:<agent>; 'general' agents serve every other agent repo. Caps count tasks started (one build, plan, PR fix or triage pass each). Account caps add up every routine on that account. scheduledTasks are not used by the dispatcher: they are Claude scheduled tasks that Mission Control shows as rows under Projects (times are HH:MM in tz; add "days": ["sat"] for a weekly one).

agents.name: admin
agents.role: Administrator: plans plan issues, sizes new issues; never writes code

agents.name: claude-1
agents.role: Fenced repos (trading app): every build and fix there

codex.role: Reviews every PR; takes over PRs an agent could not fix

antigravity.role: ui / visual tasks, worked on your Mac

scheduledTasks.name: Email triage
scheduledTasks.what: Gives each new Gmail thread one label (①緊急, ②重要 or ③其他) and sends a one-line push to your phone. Labels only: it never sends, deletes or archives mail.
